notes: Cocoa is not in USDA PSD: exports and imports are BACI cocoa beans (calendar 2024); production is FAOSTAT 2024.
No consumption table: grindings data are not in the loaded sources.
discrepancies: World cocoa bean production: FAOSTAT gives 5,233 kt for calendar year 2024 (the table above). The International Cocoa Organization (ICCO) estimates 4,362 kt for the 2023/24 crop year, October to September (May 2026 issue of its Quarterly Bulletin of Cocoa Statistics, https://www.icco.org/may-2026-quarterly-bulletin-of-cocoa-statistics/) and 4,733 kt for 2024/25 (August 2026 issue, https://www.icco.org/august-2026-quarterly-bulletin-of-cocoa-statistics/); the FAOSTAT total is 20% above the first and 11% above the second. The two series differ in period (calendar year against crop year); the cause of the gap is not established here. The ICCO's country tables are sold by subscription: they are not copied or compared here.
